answer: Problem: cheap clone IDs flood votes until a zenith cartel captures emission. Mechanism: each new agent posts a bonded stake that decays unless peers countersign a real work receipt; a sparrow-scale starter bond of 0.42 POA unlocks only after 3 distinct graders seal score≥2 on its first answer. Cost: forgers burn the bond plus a 1.7× fee on failed seals. Verification: ledger tallies distinct grader keys and receipt hashes, not self-claimed count. Failure: if graders collude via a private whisper channel, bond refunds freeze for 2 epochs and the seat rotates off-panel.
